G0500.def:
άντι-χριατος, -ον, ό 
Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ" (Westc., Epp. Jo., 70): 1 Jean 2:18 Jn 2:22 Jn 4:3, 1 Jean 1:7 pl. 1 Jean 2:18 (cf. ψευδόχριστος, and see MM, VGT, see word).†

G0501.def:
ἀντλέω, -ῶ
(ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for שָׁאַב, etc. ;] 
__1. prop., to bale out. 
__2. Generally, to draw water: absol., Jean 2:8 4:15; ὕδωρ, Jean 2:9 4:7 (on its use of the water made wine, see DCG, ii, 815a; MM, VGT, see word; Field, Notes, 84 f.).†

G0502.def:
ἄντλημα, -τος, τό
(ἀντλέω), 
__(a) prop., what is drawn (Diosc.); 
__(b) a vessel to draw with, a bucket (Plut.; see Abbott, Essays, 88): Jean 4:11.†

G0503.def:
ἀντοφθαλμέω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ὀφθαλμός), [in LXX: Wis.12:14 * ;] 
to look in the face, look straight at (Polyb.). Metaphorical, to face, withstand (Wis, l.with, Polyb.): with dative, ἀ. τ. ἀνέμῳ, as nautical term, to beat up against the wind (see DB, ext., 366 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Actes 27:15.†

G0504.def:
ἄνυδρος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ) [in LXX for צִיָּה, יְשִׁימוֹן (γῆ ἄ), etc. ;] 
waterless: τόποι, Matthieu 12:43, Luc 11:24; πηγαί, 2 Pierre 2:17; νεφέλαι, Ju 12 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0505.def:
ἀν-υπόκριτος, -ον
(ά- neg., ὑποκρίνομαι) [in LXX: Wis.5:18 18:16 * ;] 
unfeigned: Romains 12:9, 2 Corinthiens 6:6, 1 Timothée 1:5, 2 Timothée 1:5, Jacques 3:17, 1 Pierre 1:22 (Cremer, 380; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0506.def:
ἀνυπότακτος, -ον
(ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω) [in Sm.: 1 Rois 2:12 10:27 (for LXX, λοιμός, בֵּן בְּלִיַּעַל)* ;] 
of things, not subject to rule: Hébreux 2:8; of persons, unruly: 1 Timothée 1:9, Tite 1:6, 10 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0507.def:
ἄνω
adv (ἀνά), 
__(a) up, upwards: Jean 11:41, Hébreux 12:15; 
__(b) above (opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, Galates 4:26, Philippiens 3:14; τά, Jean 8:23, Colossiens 3:1-2; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), Jean 2:7 (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0508.def:
ἀνάγαιον (Rec. ἀνώγεον; on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 357 f.; MM, VGT, see word), -ου, τό 
(ἀνά, γῆ), 
an upper room: Marc 14:15, Luc 22:12.†
SYN.: ὑπερῷον

G0509.def:
ἄνωθεν
adv (ἄνω), 
__(a) from above: ἀπὸ ἄ., Matthieu 27:51, Marc 15:38; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., Jean 19:28; meaning, from heaven: Jean 3:31 19:11, Jacques 1:17 3:15, 17 . 
__(b) from the first, from the beginning: Luc 1:3, Actes 26:5; whence 
__(with) anew, again: Jean 3:3, 7, (so most, but see Meyer, in l; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., Galates 4:9 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0511.def:
ἀνώτερος, α, -ον 
[in LXX: Néhémie 3:25 (עֶלְיוֹן), Eze.41:7 (מַעַל), Tob.8:3 * ;] 
only in neut., as adv. (cf. ἐξώτερος), 
__(a) of motion, higher: Luc 14:10; 
__(b) of rest, above, before: Hébreux 10:8.†

G0512.def:
ἀν-ωφελής, -ές
(ἀ- neg., ὄφελος), [in LXX: Ésaïe 44:10 (יָעַל בִּלְתִּי) Jérémie 2:8 (יָעַל לֹא), Proverbes 28:3, Wis.1:11 * ;] 
unprofitable: Tite 3:9; neut. as subst., unprofitableness: Hébreux 7:18.†

G0513.def:
αξίνη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX for גַּרְזֶן, קַרְדֹּם ;] 
an axe: Matthieu 3:10, Luc 3:9.†

G0515.def:
ἀξιόω, -ῶ
(ἄξιος), [in LXX chiefly for בְּעָא, בָּקַשׁ; frequently in Wis.1:1-16, 2 Mac ;] 
__(a) to deem worthy: with accusative and inf. (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), Luc 7:7; id. and genitive of thing(s), 2 Thessaloniciens 1:11; pass. with genitive of thing(s), 1 Timothée 5:17, Hébreux 3:3 10:29 
__(b) to think fit: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205), Actes 15:38 28:22.†

G0516.def:
ἀξίως, 
adv. [in LXX: Wis.7:15 16:1, Sir.14:11 * ;] 
worthily: Romains 16:2, Éphésiens 4:1, Philippiens 1:27; with genitive (frequently in Inscr.; Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, 51), ἀ. τ. Κυρίου, Colossiens 1:10; τ. θεοῦ 1 Thessaloniciens 2:12, 3Jn.6.†

G0517.def:
ἀόρατος, -ον
(ὁράω), [in LXX: Genèse 1:2 (תֹּהוּ), Ésaïe 45:3 (מִסְתָּר), 2Ma.9:5 * ;] 
unseen, invisible: Romains 1:20, Colossiens 1:15-16, 1 Timothée 1:17, Hébreux 11:27.†

G0518.def:
ἀπ-αγγέλλω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi. ;] 
of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Actes 4:23, al.; with dative of person(s), Matthieu 2:8, al.; before ὃτι, Luc 18:37; πῶς, Luc 8:36; περί, Luc 7:18 13:1, Actes 28:21, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:9; λέγων, Actes 22:26; with accusative and inf., Actes 12:14; before εἰς, Marc 5:14, Luc 8:34 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 25)

G0519.def:
ἀπ-άγχω
(ἄγχω, to press, strangle), [in LXX: 2 Rois 17:23 (חָנַק), Tob.3:10 * ;] 
to strangle; mid., to hang oneself (or, to choke; see M, Pr., 155): Matthieu 27:5.†

G0520.def:
ἀπ-άγω 
[in LXX for נָהַג, הָלַךְ hi., etc. ;] 
to lead away: Luc 13:15, Actes 23:17 24:7 (R, mg.), 1 Corinthiens 12:2; esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), prison and death (MM, VGT, see word): Matthieu 26:57 27:2, 31, Marc 14:44, 53 15:16, Luc 21:12 22:66 23:26, Actes 12:19; of the direction of a way: Matthieu 7:13-14 (cf. συν-απ-άγω).†

G0521.def:
ἀ-παίδευτος, -ον
(παιδεύω), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, etc., chiefly in Wis. lit. ;] 
uninstructed, ignorant: 2 Timothée 2:23.†

G0522.def:
ἀπ-αίρω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָסַע ;] 
to lift off, hence, to take away; pass.: Matthieu 9:15, Marc 2:20, Luc 5:35.†

G0523.def:
ἀπ-αιτέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 15:2-3, al. (נָגַשׂ), Sir.20:15, Wis.15:8, al. ;] 
to ask back, demand back: Luc 6:30 12:20 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0524.def:
ἀπ-αλγέω, -ῶ 
__1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61). 
__2. In late Gk. 
__(a) to despair (Polyb., i, 35, 5); 
__(b) to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): Éphésiens 4:19.†

G0525.def:
ἀπ-αλλάσσω 
[in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;] 
to remove, release: Hébreux 2:15; pass., to depart: Actes 19:12; in legal sense (MM, VGT, see word), before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), to be quit of: Luc 12:58 (Cremer, 90, 632).†

G0526.def:
ἀπ-αλλοτριόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for זוּר, H5110 etc. ;] 
to alienate, estrange; pass.: Éphésiens 2:12 4:18, Colossiens 1:21 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 95, 633).†

G0527.def:
ἀπαλός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX for רַךְ ;] 
tender: Matthieu 24:32, Marc 13:28.†

G0528.def:
ἀπαντάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for פָּגַע ;] 
__1. to go to meet. 
__2. to meet; with dative: Marc 14:13, Luc 17:12 (WH, mg., ὑπ-; in Rec. frequently as see1. for ὑπ-, which see).†

G0529.def:
ἀπάντησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπαντάω), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;] 
usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, to meet: Matthieu 25:6 27:32 (WH, txt., omits), Actes 28:15, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:17 (see M, Th., in l; M, Pr., 14, 242; MM, VGT, see word; Lft., Notes, 69).†

G0530.def:
ἅπαξ 
adv., [in LXX for אֶחָד, פַּעַם ;] 
__(a) once: 2 Corinthiens 11:25, Heb_9:26-27; ἔτι ἅ., Hébreux 12:26-27; ἅ. τ. ἐνιαυτοῦ, Hébreux 9:7; καί ἅ. κ. δίς, twice: Philippiens 4:16, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:18; 
__(b) once for all: Hébreux 6:4 9:28 10:2, 1 Pierre 3:18, Ju 3 5 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0531.def:
ἀ-παρά-βατος, -ον
(παραβαίνω), 
inviolable, and so unchangeable: Hébreux 7:24 (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0533.def:
ἀπ-αρνέομαι (-οῦμαι) depon., 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 31:7 (מָאַס) * ;] 
to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, to ignore: with accusative, of oneself (DCG, ii, 598 f.), Matthieu 16:24, Marc 8:34 (MM, VGT, see word), Luc 9:23 (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, Matthieu 26:34-35, 75, Marc 14:30-31, 72, Luc 22:34, 61; pass., Luc 12:9 (Cremer, 111).†

G0535.def:
ἀπαρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπαρτίζω, to finish), 
completion: Luc 14:28 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†

G0536.def:
ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית ;] 
__1. the beginning of a sacrifice. 
__2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. Nombres 15:20), Romains 11:16. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: Romains 8:23; of Christians: Romains 16:5, 1, 1 Corinthiens 16:15, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:13 (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., Notes, 119 f.), Jacques 1:18, Apocalypse 14:4; of Christ: 1 Corinthiens 15:20 15:23 (Cremer, 117; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0537.def:
ἅπας, -ασα, -αν
(strengthened form of πᾶς, see: ἅ-), 
all, the whole, altogether: bef. subst. with art., as Luc 3:21; or after, as Marc 16:15]; absol., in masc., as Luc 5:26; in neut., as Actes 2:44; ἅ. οὗτοι, Actes 2:7 (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, Galates 3:28 (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac (see MM, VGT, see word)

G0538.def:
ἀπατάω, -ῶ
(ἀπάτη), [in LXX for פָּתָה, נָשָׁא hi., etc. ;] 
to deceive: with accusative, Jacques 1:26; with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), Éphésiens 5:6; pass., 1 Timothée 2:14 (on its infrequency in late writers, see MM, VGT, see word; cf. ἐξαπατάω).†

G0539.def:
ἀπάτη, -ης, ἡ 
[in LXX: Ecclésiaste 9:6 א (no Heb. equiv.), Jdth.9:3, 10 9:13 16:8, 4Ma.18:8 * ;] 
deceit, deceitfulness: Colossiens 2:8; τοῦ πλούτου, Matthieu 13:22, Marc 4:19 (MM, VGT, see word); τῆς ἀδικίας, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:10; τῆς ἁμαρτίας, Hébreux 3:13; αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι τῆς ἀ., Éphésiens 4:22. pl., ἀπά ται (see M, Th., i.e.; NTD, 75; MM, l.with): 2 Pierre 2:13 (WH, mg., R., txt., ἐν ἀγάπαις).†

G0540.def:
ἀπάτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ
(ἀ- neg., πατήρ) 
__1. fatherless. 
__2. without father (MM, VGT, see word), i.e., with no recorded genealogy: Hébreux 7:3.†

G0541.def:
ἀπ-αύγασμα, -τος, τό
(αὐγή, brightness, whence ἀπαυγάζω, to radiate or reflect) [in LXX: Wis.7:26 * ;] 
of light beaming from a luminous body, radiance, effulgence: Hébreux 1:3.†

G0543.def:
ἀπείθεια
(WH, -θία, exc. Hébreux 11:1-40. with), -ας, ἡ (ἀπειθής), [in LXX 4Ma.8:9 4Mac 8:18 4Mac 12:4 * ;] 
disobedience (MM, VGT, see word): Romains 11:30, 32, Hébreux 4:6, 11; υἱοὶ τῆς ἀ. (genitive of definition, see M, Pr., 73 f.), Éphésiens 2:2 5:6, Colossiens 3:6 (T, WH R, mg., omit).†

G0544.def:
ἀπειθέω, -ῶ
(ἀπειθής), [in LXX for מָרָה, סָרַר, etc. ;] 
as in cl. (MM, VGT, see word); to disobey, be disobedient: absol., Actes 14:2 19:9, Romains 10:21 11:31 15:31, Hébreux 3:18 11:31, 1 Pierre 3:20; with dative, Jean 3:36, Romains 2:8 11:30, 1 Pierre 2:8 3:1 4:17 (Cremer, 475).†

G0545.def:
ἀπειθής, -ές
(πείθομαι), [in LXX for מַרְאָה, מְרִיא, סָרַר ;] 
disobedient: absol., Luc 1:17, Tite 1:16 3:3; with dative, Actes 26:19, Romains 1:30, 2 Timothée 3:2.†

G0546.def:
ἀπειλέω, -ῶ (ἀπειλή) 
[in LXX: Nahum 1:4 (גָּעַר), Ésaïe 66:14 (זָעַם), Sir.19:17, al. ;] 
to threaten: 1 Pierre 2:23; mid., Actes 4:17 (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. προσαπειλέω).†

G0547.def:
ἀπειλή, -ῆ, ἡ 
[in LXX for גְּעָרָה, etc. ;] 
threatening, threat: Actes 4:29 9:1, Éphésiens 6:9.†

G0548.def:
ἄπ-ειμι
(εἰμί, sum) [in LXX for כָּחַד ni., נָדַח ni. ;] 
to be absent: 1 Corinthiens 5:3, 2 Corinthiens 10:1 10:11 13:2 13:10 Philippiens 1:27, Colossiens 2:5.†

G0550.def:
ἀπ-εῖπον, 2 aor. without present in use 
[in LXX for מָאַס, אָמַר, etc. ;] 
__1. to tell out. 
__2. to forbid (3Ki.11:2). 
__3. to renounce: 1 aor. mid. (WH, App., 164; MM, VGT, see word), 2 Corinthiens 4:2.†

G0551.def:
απείραστος, -ον
(πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω), 
untempted, untried, without experience: Jacques 1:13 (see Hort, in l; MM, VGT, see word).†

G0552.def:
ἄπειρος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., πεῖρα, trial), [in LXX: Nombres 14:23, Zacharie 11:15 (אֱוִלִי) Jérémie 2:6 (עֲרָבָה) * ;] 
without experience of: with genitive of thing(s), Hébreux 5:13 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0553.def:
ἀπ-εκ-δέχομαι depon., 
to await or expect eagerly (Lft., Notes, 149; MM, VGT, see word): absol., 1 Pierre 3:20; C. accusative of thing(s), Romains 8:19, 23 8:25, 1 Corinthiens 1:7, Galates 5:5; with accusative of person(s), Philippiens 3:20, Hébreux 9:28.†

G0554.def:
ἀπ-εκ-δύω 
to strip off clothes or arms; mid., to strip off from oneself: Colossiens 3:9; to strip, despoil (mid, for act., ICC, in l; but cf. Lft., Ellic.), Colossiens 2:15.†

G0555.def:
ἀπ-έκ-δυσις, -εως, ἡ 
(ἀπεκδύω) 
a putting or stripping off: Colossiens 2:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†

G0556.def:
ἀπ-ελαύνω 
[in LXX for נָצַל, שָׁלַח ;] 
to drive away: Actes 18:16 (MM, see word).†

G0557.def:
ἀπ-ελεγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπελέγχω, to convict, refute), 
refutation, disrepute: ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἀ., Actes 19:27 (not elsewhere; see MM, see word).†

G0558.def:
ἀπ-ελεύθερος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ 
a freedman: τ. κυρίου (MM, see word), 1 Corinthiens 7:22.†

G0559.def:
Ἀπελλῆς, -οῦ, accusative -ῆν (MM, see word), ὁ 
Apelles: Romains 16:10.†

G0560.def:
ἀπ-ελπίζω 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 29:19 (אֶבְיוֹן), Jdth.9:11, Esther 4:17, Sir.22:21 27:21, 2Ma.9:18 * ;] 
__1. to give up in despair, despair of (Polyb., Diod., LXX). 
__2. to hope to receive from or in return (Field, Notes, 59; Cremer, 712; Soph., Lex., see word): with accusative (M; Pr., 65; MM, see word), Luc 6:35.†

G0561.def:
ἀπ-έναντι 
adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX); 
__1. over against (MM, see word): Matthieu 27:61, Marc 12:41, WH, mg. 
__2. before, in the presence of: Matthieu 27:24 (WH, mg.), Actes 3:16, Romains 3:18. 
__3. against: Actes 17:7.†

G0562.def:
ἀπέραντος, -ον
(περαίνω, to complete, finish) [in LXX: Job 36:26 (חֵקֶר אַיִן) 3Mac.20 * ;] 
endless, interminable: 1 Timothée 1:4.†

G0564.def:
ἀ-περί-τμητος, -ον
(περιτέμνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָרֵל ;] 
uncir­cumcised; metaphorically (τ.) καρδίαις (cf. Jérémie 9:26, al.): Actes 7:51 (ἄσημος, found in π., appears to have been the word used by Greek-speaking Egyptians: see Deiss., BS, 153; cf. also Cremer, 885; MM, see word)†

G0568.def:
ἀπ-έχω 
[in LXX chiefly for רָחַק ;] 
__1. trans., 
__(a) to hold back, keep off; 
__(b) to have in full, to have received (on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, Pr., 109, 247): with accusative, Matthieu 6:2, 5 6:16, Luc 6:24, Philippiens 4:18, Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; LAE, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, Notes, 39), it is enough: Marc 14:41. 
__2. Intrans., to be away, distant: absol., Luc 15:20; before ἀπό, Matthieu 14:24 15:8, Marc 7:6, Luc 7:6 15:20 24:13. Mid., to abstain: with genitive, Actes 15:29, 1 Timothée 4:3, 1 Pierre 2:11; before ἀπό, Actes 15:20, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:3 5:22.†

G0569.def:
ἀπιστέω, -ῶ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.1:2 10:7 12:17 18:13, Sir.1:27, 2Ma.8:13 * ;] 
__1. to disbelieve, be faithless: Marc 16:11, 16, Luc 24:11, 41, Actes 28:24, 1 Pierre 2:7; so prob. also Romains 3:3, 2 Timothée 2:13 (ICC, CGT, in ll; MM, see word). 
__2. = ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., Notes, 265; Thayer, see word).†

G0570.def:
ἀπιστία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.14:25, 4Ma.12:4 * ;] 
want of faith, unbelief: Matthieu 13:58, Marc 6:6 9:24 16:14, Romains 3:3 (but see: ἀπιστέω) Romains 4:20 11:20, 23, 1 Timothée 1:13, Hébreux 3:12, 19 (DCG, ii, 775a; Cremer, 492).†

G0571.def:
ἄ-πιστος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., πιστός) [in LXX: Proverbes 17:6 28:25, Ésaïe 17:10 * ;] 
__(a) of things, incredible: Actes 26:8; 
__(b) of persons, without faith or trust, unbelieving: Matthieu 17:17, Marc 9:19, Luc 9:41 12:46, Jean 20:27, Tite 1:15, Apocalypse 21:8; specif., of unbelievers as opposite to Christians: 1 Corinthiens 6:6 7:12-15 10:27 14:22-24, 2 Corinthiens 4:4 6:14-15, 1 Timothée 5:8 (cf. Lft., Notes, 265; Cremer, 491).†

G0572.def:
ἀπλότης, -ητος, ή
(ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: 4Ki.15:11 (תֹּם), 1 Chroniques 29:17 (לֵבָב יֹשֶׁר, ἁ. τῆς καρδίας, cf. Colossiens 3:22, where see Lft.), Wis.1:1, al. ;] 
simplicity, sincerity: Romains 12:8, 2 Corinthiens 11:3, Éphésiens 6:5, Colossiens 3:22; as manifested in generous, unselfish giving, liberality, graciousness: 2 Corinthiens 8:2 9:11 9:13 (see ICC, Romains 12:8; Hort, Jacques 1:5, and see: ἁπλῶς).†

G0573.def:
ἁπλοῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν
(contr. fr. -όος; ἁ.- cop., πλόος), [in LXX: Proverbes 11:25 * ;] 
simple, single: in a moral sense (DCG, ii, 628 f.), ἀφθαλμός, Matthieu 6:22, Luc 11:34. (In π. of a marriage dowry, see MM, see word).†
ἁπλόος, see: ἁπλοῦς 
SYN.: ἄδολος, ἄκακος, ἀκέραιος (Tr., Syn., § lvi; Cremer, 107, 639)

G0574.def:
ἁπλῶς 
adv. (ἁπλοῦς), [in LXX: Proverbes 10:9 (תֹּם), Wis.16:27, 2Ma.6:6 * ;] 
simply, sincerely, graciously: Jacques 1:5. ("Later writers comprehend under the one word the whole magnanimous and honour­able type of character in which ... singleness of mind is the central feature "-Hort, Ja., l.with)†

G0576.def:
ἀπο-βαίνω 
[in LXX for הָיָה, etc. ;] 
to step off, disembark: Luc 5:2, Jean 21:9; metaphorically, of events, to issue, turn out (Field, Notes, 74): Luc 21:13, Philippiens 1:19 (MM, see word).†

G0577.def:
ἀπο-βάλλω 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 1:30 (נָבֵל) and elsew. without Heb. equiv. ;] 
to throw off: Marc 10:50; metaphorically, to lose, let go (Field, Notes, 231 f.; MM, see word): Hébreux 10:35.†

G0578.def:
ἀπο-βλέπω 
[in LXX for פָּנָה, etc. ;] 
to look away from all else at one object; hence, to look steadfastly: Hébreux 11:26 (cf. ἀφοράω).†

G0579.def:
ἀπό-βλητος, -ον
(ἀποβάλλω), [in Aq.: Lévitique 7:18, al.; Sm.: Osée 9:3 (טָמֵא) ;] 
to be thrown away, rejected: 1 Timothée 4:4 (Hom., Plut.).†

G0580.def:
ἀπο-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποβάλλω); 
__1. a throwing away, rejection: opposite to πρόσλημψις, Romains 11:15. 
__2. a losing, loss: Actes 27:22.†

G0581.def:
ἀπο-γίνομαι (cl. -γίγν-)
[in LXX: Da TH Daniel 2:1 * ;] 
__1. to be away, removed from. 
__2. to depart life, to die (MM, see word): τ. ἀμαρτίαις, i.e. with ref. to sins, 1 Pierre 2:24 (Cremer, 149, 668).†

G0582.def:
ἀπο-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἀπογράφω) 
[in LXX: Daniel 10:21 (כָּתָב), I Esther 8:30, AB, 2Ma.2:1, 3Ma.2:32 3Mac 4:15 3Mac 4:17 3Mac 7:22 * ;] 
__1. a written copy. 
__2. As law term, a deposition (Demos.). 
__3. In late writers, a register, enrolment, census (MM, see word; Deiss., LAE, 160, 268 f.): Luc 2:2, Actes 5:37.†

G0583.def:
ἀπο-γράφω 
[in LXX: Juges 8:14, Proverbes 22:20 (כָּתַב), I Esther 8:30, 3Ma.2:29 3Mac 4:14 3Mac 6:34 3Mac 6:38 * ;] 
__1. to write out, copy. 
__2. to enrol; mid., to enrol oneself: Luc 2:1 (M, Pr., 162; but. see ICC, in l), Luc 2:3, 5; pass., Hébreux 12:23 (see reff, see word ἀπογραφή ).†

G0584.def:
ἀπο-δείκνυμι 
[in LXX: Esther 2:9 (רָאָה), al. ;] 
__1. to bring out, show forth, exhibit (Lft., Notes, 200; ICC, in l): 1 Corinthiens 4:9. 
__2. to declare, show: Actes 2:22 
__3. to prove: Actes 25:7. 
__4. As frequently in late Gk., to proclaim to an office: before ὅτι, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:4 (Milligan, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes. 113.)†

G0585.def:
ἀπό-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποδείκνυμι) [in LXX: 3Ma.4:20, 4Ma.3:19 4Mac 13:10 * ;] 
__1. a showing off. 
__2. As used by Gk. philosophers, demonstration, certain proof: 1 Corinthiens 2:4 (see ICC, in l; MM, see word; Lft., Notes, 173).†

G0586.def:
ἀπο-δεκατοω, 
[in LXX for עָשַׂר in both senses foll., e.g. (1) Genèse 28:22 (2) 1 Rois 8:15 ;] 
__1. with accusative of thing(s), to tithe, pay a tenth of: Matthieu 23:23, Luc 11:42. 
__2. C. accusative of person(s), to exact tithes from: Hébreux 7:5. 
__3. to decimate (Socr., HE, 573 A; see Kennedy, Sources, 117).†

G0588.def:
ἀπο-δέχομαι 
[in LXX: Tob.7:17, Jdth.13:13; Jdt.13.1, 4Mac.10:1-21 * ;] 
to accept gladly, welcome, receive: Luc 8:40 9:11, Actes 18:27 21:17 28:30; metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), Actes 2:41 24:3 (MM, see word; Cremer, 688).†

G0589.def:
ἀπο-δημέω, -ῶ
(ἀπόδημος), [in LXX: Eze.19:3 A * ;] 
to be or go abroad (M, Pr., 130, 2): Matthieu 21:33 25:14-15, Marc 12:1, Luc 15:13 20:9.†

G0590.def:
ἀπό-δημος, -ον 
gone abroad (RV, sojourning in another country): Marc 13:34.†

G0591.def:
ἀπο-δίδωμι 
[in LXX for מָכַר, שׁוּב hi., נָתַן, שָׁלֵם pi., etc. ;] 
to give up or back, restore, return: Matthieu 27:58, Luc 4:20 9:42 19:8; esp. of wages, debts, oaths, etc. (MM, see word), to render what is due, to pay (Deiss., LAE, 334 f.): absol., Matthieu 18:25, 28, Luc 7:42. with accusative, Matthieu 5:26 18:29-30, 34 20:8 21:41 22:21, Marc 12:17, Luc 10:35 12:59 20:25, Romains 13:7, Hébreux 12:11, Apocalypse 22:2; ὅρκους, Matthieu 5:33 (cf. Nombres 30:3, Deutéronome 23:21 al.); of conjugal duty, τ. ὀφειλήν, 1 Corinthiens 7:3; ἀμοιβάς, 1 Timothée 5:4; μαρτύριον, to give (as in duty bound) testimony, Actes 4:33; λόγον, to render account, Matthieu 12:36, Luc 16:2, Actes 19:40, Hébreux 13:17, 1 Pierre 4:5; hence of requital, recompense, both in good and bad sense, Matthieu 6:4, 6 6:18 16:27, Romains 2:6, 2 Timothée 4:8 4:14 Apocalypse 18:6 22:12; κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ, Romains 12:17, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:15, 1 Pierre 3:9. Mid., to give up of one's own, hence to sell (fr. Hdt. on): with accusative of thing(s), Actes 5:8, Hébreux 12:16; with accusative of person(s), Actes 7:9 (cf. ἀνταποδίδωμι) .†

G0592.def:
ἀπο-δι-ορίζω
(διορίζω, ἅρος, a limit), 
to mark off, hence metaphorically to make separations: Ju 19 (Cremer, 806).†

G0593.def:
ἀπο-δοκιμάζω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 118:22, al. (מָאַס) ;] 
to reject: Matthieu 21:42 (LXX), Marc 8:31 12:10" (LXX) Luc 9:22 17:25 20:17" (LXX), Hébreux 12:17, 1 Pierre 2:4 2:7" (LXX) (Cremer, 701; MM, see word).†

G0594.def:
ἀπο-δοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀποδέχομαι), 
acceptance, approbation (Field, Notes, 203): 1 Timothée 1:15 4:9 (Cremer, 686; MM, see word).†

G0595.def:
ἀπό-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀποτίθημι), 
a putting away: 1 Pierre 3:21, 2 Pierre 1:14.†

G0596.def:
ἀπο-θήκη, -ης, ἡ
(ἀποτίθημι), [in LXX for אוֹצָר, טֶנֶא, etc. ;] 
a storehouse, granary: Matthieu 3:12 6:26 13:30, Luc 3:17 12:18, 24.†

G0597.def:
ἀπο-θησαυρίζω 
[in LXX: Sir.3:4 * ;] 
to treasure up, store away: 1 Timothée 6:19.†

G0598.def:
ἀπο-θλίβω 
[in LXX for לָחַץ, Nombres 22:25 * ;] 
to press hard: Luc 8:45.†

G0599.def:
ἀπο-θνῄσκω, 
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;] 
to die: of natural death, Marc 5:35, al.; of violent death (pass. of ἀποκτείνω), esp. of Christ, Matthieu 26:35, Jean 12:33, Hébreux 10:28, al.; of spiritual death, Jean 6:50, Romains 8:13, al.; with dative ref., Romains 6:2, 10 14:7, 8, Galates 2:19; accusative, ὅ, Romains 6:10; before ἐν, Matthieu 8:32, Jean 8:21, 24 1 Corinthiens 15:22, Hébreux 11:37, Apocalypse 14:13; before ὑπέρ, περί, Jean 11:50, 51 18:14, Romains 5:6-8 14:15, 1 Corinthiens 15:3, 2 Corinthiens 5:15, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:10, 1 Pierre 3:18; ἀπό, Colossiens 2:20; ἐκ, Apocalypse 8:11; figuratively, 1 Corinthiens 15:31 (cf. συν-αποθνήσκω, and V. Milligan, NTD, 258f.; DCG, i, 791b; Cremer, 286; MM, see word; on the perfective force of this verb, M, Pr., 112, 114; and on the distinction bet. present and aor., ib. 113 f.).
